WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.striker,
        bb.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
extras AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.striker,
        bb.non_striker,
        COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
player_scores AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM extras
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT match_id, player_id, SUM(total_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM player_scores
    GROUP BY match_id, player_id
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        LEAST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker) AS p1,
        GREATEST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker) AS p2,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, LEAST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker), GREATEST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker)
),
ranked_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        p.*,
        MAX(p.total_partnership_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY p.match_id) AS max_partnership_runs
    FROM partnerships p
),
ordered_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        rp.match_id,
        CASE WHEN ps1.total_runs > ps2.total_runs OR (ps1.total_runs = ps2.total_runs AND ps1.player_id > ps2.player_id)
             THEN ps1.player_id ELSE ps2.player_id END AS player1_id,
        CASE WHEN ps1.total_runs > ps2.total_runs OR (ps1.total_runs = ps2.total_runs AND ps1.player_id > ps2.player_id)
             THEN ps2.player_id ELSE ps1.player_id END AS player2_id,
        CASE WHEN ps1.total_runs > ps2.total_runs OR (ps1.total_runs = ps2.total_runs AND ps1.player_id > ps2.player_id)
             THEN ps1.total_runs ELSE ps2.total_runs END AS player1_runs,
        CASE WHEN ps1.total_runs > ps2.total_runs OR (ps1.total_runs = ps2.total_runs AND ps1.player_id > ps2.player_id)
             THEN ps2.total_runs ELSE ps1.total_runs END AS player2_runs,
        rp.total_partnership_runs
    FROM ranked_partnerships rp
    JOIN individual_scores ps1 ON rp.match_id = ps1.match_id AND rp.p1 = ps1.player_id
    JOIN individual_scores ps2 ON rp.match_id = ps2.match_id AND rp.p2 = ps2.player_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as match_count
FROM ordered_partnerships
WHERE total_partnership_runs = (SELECT MAX(total_partnership_runs) FROM partnerships WHERE match_id = ordered_partnerships.match_id)
